Definition: from a compound of G1537 and τιτρώσκω (to wound); a miscarriage (abortion), i.e. (by analogy) untimely birth:--born out of due time.
BiblicalUsage: éktrōma is the word for one born out of due time. In 1 Corinthians 15:8, the text says "as of one born out of due time."
TheologicalSignificance: For me, éktrōma means one born out of due time, and I leave it at that.
